metrics_md: `kcal_ok` is the headline: for a precisely-specified meal, within 15% of the reference computed from its per-100 g components; for a vague one, anywhere inside the plausible range. `kcal_bias_pct` is signed and is the number that matters most over time — a model that is consistently high corrupts the expenditure estimate in one direction, which is worse than one that is noisy but centred. `macro_mae_g` is the mean absolute error across protein, carbs and fat in grams.
